name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 57 - Am 96
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 57 a. Opposes the use of the EU budget to finance the rearmament of Member States under the ReArm Europe Plan, as such expenditure contravenes Article 41(2) of the Treaty on European Union; expresses concern that the allocation of Union funds to military purposes undermines the EU’s financial autonomy and diverts resources from civilian objectives; recalls that the Union’s budget should primarily serve to support programmes that respond to citizens’ needs, strengthen public services, and improve living standards across the Union.
